name: drishti-common
//: Deps are what the wire contract needs at runtime: surface.ts uses Effect Schema and @kolu/surface/define (which pulls effect/unstable/rpc). @kolu/surface is hydrated from the Nix store, not bun.lock, so its support deps must be declared by consumers — here for the contract, and in drishti-agent for the server/peer-server it serves. `effect` is pinned to the EXACT version the hydrated @kolu/surface* sources declare (4.0.0-beta.102): a vendored source and its consumer must agree on one copy, or `_tag` narrowing across two module instances silently stops recognising anything.
